mapper.insert: insert into sleave_log(sabun, leave_type, use_date, use_days, reason, created_at, approve) values(#{sabun}, #{leave_type}, #{use_date}, #{use_days}, #{reason}, now(), DEFAULT);
mapper.update: update sleave_log set approve = 1, approved_at=now() WHERE log_id = #{log_id}
mapper.select: SELECT s.saname, d.dname, l.leave_type, l.use_date, l.use_days, l.reason, l.created_at FROM sleave_log l JOIN sawon s ON l.sabun = s.sabun JOIN dept d ON s.deptno = d.deptno WHERE s.saname = #{search_name} ORDER BY l.approved_at DESC
mapper.update: update sleave_log set approve = 2 , reject_reason = #{reject_reason} WHERE log_id = #{log_id}
